title: Eye Evict: Skip Admin-Elevated Processes with Null Cmdline
desc: When eye-evict fires, processes with null GetProcessCommandLine output are admin-elevated; skip window check before eviction to avoid false eviction of elevated processes.
steps: When eye-evict triggers, call GetProcessCommandLine on the target process. If it returns null or empty, treat the process as admin-elevated (UAC-restricted) and skip the window check before eviction decision.
Fix deployed in commit 8b633583: guard added in EyeCommand evict path. Prevents false eviction of elevated processes (e.g., Heroes4/HTS running as admin) during Eye scan cycles.

If eye-evict causes unexpected process eviction on HTS/Heroes4, check if the process is running as administrator. Use 'wkappbot eye tick' to verify eye state. Null cmdline on a process = admin token; the guard skips such processes automatically.
author: claude
